lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y₂Si₆O₄ (Y(SiO₂)₃) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Si centers in tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors, while Y centers have eight O neighbors; O centers are also eight-coordinate, surrounded by Si and Y neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Si tetrahedra and between Si tetrahedra and 8-vertex O polyhedra, with additional corner- and face-sharing between 8-vertex O polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
